title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Share at Which Arrears Charges Are Collected on Settlement
content:
## Collections schedule

The charges for instalments left unpaid on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record are collected, in a settlement, at a share that falls as they multiply. The count is of those charges standing on the agreement.

| Charges for instalments left unpaid standing on the agreement | Share they are collected at |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the multi-notice share, 40 percent of them |
| 1 or 2 | the second notice share, 60 percent of them |
| none | collected in full |

### Schedule notes

- At a count of exactly 3 the multi-notice share of 40 percent applies; at a count of exactly 2 the second notice share of 60 percent applies.
- The share acts on the total of those charges, not on each of them separately.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

An agreement carrying 3 charges for instalments left unpaid totalling 250.00 USD collects 40 percent of 250.00 USD, that is 100.00 USD, into the settlement figure. Carrying 2 such charges totalling the same amount, it collects 60 percent of 250.00 USD, that is 150.00 USD.
